Job Title: Prompt Engineer

Experience: 5+ Years
Location: Pune

Job Description:

We are looking for an experienced Prompt Engineer to design, develop, test, and optimize prompts for Large Language Models (LLMs) to improve AI response quality, accuracy, and relevance.

Key Responsibilities:

Design and optimize prompts for LLM-based applications.
Test and refine prompts to improve model performance.
Analyze AI responses and implement improvements.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams on AI solutions.
Mentor team members and contribute to technical decisions.

Required Skills:

Strong experience in Prompt Engineering.
Good understanding of LLMs, Generative AI, and NLP.
Programming experience in Python.
Familiarity with AI playgrounds and prompt testing tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Education: 15 years of full-time education required.
